profile.legalName: Families In Action For Quality Education
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, founded in 2019 by school leaders and families in East Oakland. It works to improve access to quality public schools, especially for Black, Brown and underserved students. It runs parent and youth leadership institutes, a family literacy program called Lit for Literacy, and student leadership programs in district and charter schools.
